system: You read one turn of texts to a booking assistant and map each part of it to one verb. Use only the choices listed, by their ids. Quote each part's exact words.

messages.content:
<who>Sam Lee, owner of biz-lees-barbershop, owner of biz-lee-home-services, language en</who>
<open_questions>
oq-s1-02 (step S1-02, Lee's Barbershop, asked 1 time)
</open_questions>
<choices>
c-01 (option, answers oq-s1-02): All on the list. A plug-in holds what one kind of work needs. Fields: kinds (text).
c-02 (option, answers oq-s1-02): One isn't on the list yet. a service with a visit that Rosie has no plug-in for. Fields: kinds (text).
c-03 (option, answers oq-s1-02): Not a service we book. goods with no visit, delivery only, renting a thing alone, or work the law bars. Fields: kinds (text).
c-04 (door, door unclearOwnerOrHelp): An unclear owner text or HELP. Nothing changes on a text Rosie can't act on for sure.
c-05 (anytime, any-time row danger-or-crisis): Danger or crisis. Every message and every call is checked before any answer, every time, by meaning.
</choices>
<recent_messages>
rosie: Hi! I'm Rosie, an automated assistant. I'll set up your business so AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini can book you. What kinds of work do you do? Just type them.
</recent_messages>
<turn>Barbershop, plumbing, electrical</turn>

schema.title: DecideRead
schema.description: What one decide read returns: the model's verbs, one per part of the text (arch 03 line 183; arch 02 line 119: 'The output is the model's verbs'). Model-facing: written inside the structured-outputs subset and checked by contracts/scripts/structured-subset-lint.mjs (02-contracts section 2 item 7).

language.description: The text's language, as this read sees it; the two reads must agree (CQ-07 default; arch 06 line 341).

parts.description: One verb per part of the text, in the text's order (arch 03 line 183).

language.title: Language
language.description: A language as a two-letter lowercase code, such as en or es (arch 06 line 341: 'It answers in the language of the text'; contracts/bundle fixedLine.lang uses the same form). Which codes are checked languages is a code check against the bundle's fixed lines.

decidePart.title: DecidePart
decidePart.description: One verb for one part of the text: choose, enter, ask, none_fits, pass_on, hand_off, redact or no_op (arch 03 line 183). Any other verb is refused (refuse-unknown-verb). Model-facing.

choose.title: Choose
choose.description: choose(question, option, fields with their source words): the part answers an offered question or hub case (arch 03 line 183). Model-facing.

question.description: The question the option answers, exactly as the chosen choice's question gives it (arch 03 line 183).

choice.description: The chosen option's choice id, one of the turn's choices of kind option, hub or whichBooking (arch 03 line 183; arch 06 line 333: 'Code hands it the choices'). Checked in code, never an enum (README 'Named rules').

fields.description: The fields its answer carries, each with its words (arch 03 line 183).

enter.title: Enter
enter.description: enter(door or any-time row, fields): the part starts something new or raises an any-time row (arch 03 line 183); also an entry step meaning search added (arch 03 line 189). Model-facing.

choice.description: The door's, any-time row's or entry step's choice id, one of the turn's choices of kind door, anytime or searchEntry (arch 03 lines 183 and 189). Checked in code (README 'Named rules').

fields.description: The fields its answer carries, each with its words (arch 03 line 183).

ask.title: Ask
ask.description: ask(questions, what is unclear): the part could answer more than one question, or a bare reply or reaction is not a choice, so Rosie asks which (arch 03 lines 183 and 187; S13-12; A7-17). Model-facing.

questions.description: The questions it could answer, by the choices' question values (arch 03 line 183).

unclear.description: What is unclear, in plain words (arch 03 line 183).

noneFits.title: NoneFits
noneFits.description: none_fits(why): no choice fits the part; meaning search runs (arch 03 lines 183 and 189). Model-facing.

passOn.title: PassOn
passOn.description: pass_on(words): the part is words for the business, passed on as they are (arch 03 line 183). Model-facing.

words.description: The words to pass on (arch 03 line 183).

handOff.title: HandOff
handOff.description: hand_off(reason): the part goes to a person (arch 03 line 183), routed by about: a report about the owner or staff to Rosie's team that day, any other hand-off to the owner in text hours, then Rosie's team (arch 06 line 329). Model-facing.

reason.description: Why it goes to a person (arch 03 line 183).

redact.title: Redact
redact.description: redact(words): words that must not stay in the message log or reach a message, such as a field kept to the secure page (arch 03 line 183; RULES 4.5). Model-facing.

words.description: The words to redact, found in the text (arch 03 line 183).

noOp.title: NoOp
noOp.description: no_op: the part needs nothing done, such as a thank-you (arch 03 line 183). Model-facing.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: The part's exact quote from the turn's texts; code confirms it is found in their words (arch 03 line 185: 'each part is quoted exactly, and code confirms the quote'). Model-facing.

field.title: Field
field.description: One field of a choose or enter, with its source words (arch 03 line 183: 'fields with their source words'). A value without words is refused (refuse-value-without-words). Model-facing.

name.description: The field's name, one the chosen choice lists in its fields (contracts/bundle answerField.name; arch 03 line 183).

words.description: The exact words of the text the value comes from; code re-parses the value from them (arch 03 line 185; arch 06 line 309, limit 6).

nonEmptyText.title: NonEmptyText
nonEmptyText.description: Words with at least one character that is not a space, written as a pattern because the structured-outputs subset has no string-length limits (02-contracts section 2 item 7; arch 03 line 185: each part is quoted exactly and each value has its words).

handOffAbout.title: HandOffAbout
handOffAbout.description: Whom a hand-off is about, so the hand-off code (C-104) routes it without reading the reason: ownerOrStaff, a report about the owner or staff, which goes to Rosie's team that day, never the person named (arch 06 line 329: 'a report about the owner or staff: Rosie's team that day, never the person named'; S13-29 rule 58: 'A report that the owner or staff harmed someone goes to Rosie's team that day, never only to the one named'; S13-27 rule 36's note: 'If it's about the owner or staff, or is sent to Rosie itself, only Rosie's team gets it'); other, any other hand-off, which goes to the owner in text hours, then Rosie's team after 2 days unanswered (arch 06 line 329; S11-19). A closed enum of scalars, inside the structured-outputs subset (02-contracts section 2 item 7). Model-facing.

fieldValue.title: FieldValue
fieldValue.description: The value the model read for a field, in the type the choice's field names (contracts/bundle answerField.type): a string for text, zone, id or choice; an integer; a boolean; money or a time as the shared formats write them (CQ-09). Code re-parses it from its words (arch 03 line 185; arch 06 line 309, limit 6). Model-facing.

money.title: Money
money.description: An amount of money: whole cents with its currency code, never a decimal (CQ-09). Whether an amount may be zero or negative is each field's rule, checked in code.

cents.description: The amount in the currency's cents, as an integer (CQ-09).

time.title: Time
time.description: A time: the instant in UTC together with the IANA zone it is shown and reasoned in (CQ-09: 'every time in UTC with its IANA zone'; S13-03).

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: A currency code: three capital letters, as ISO 4217 writes them, for example USD (CQ-09: 'money in integer cents with a currency code').

utc.title: Utc
utc.description: An instant in UTC, written as an RFC 3339 date-time ending in Z, for example 2026-11-07T15:30:00Z (CQ-09: 'every time in UTC'). Whether the date exists is a code check.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: An IANA time zone name, for example America/New_York (CQ-09; S13-03: a visit's time is read in the visit's zone). Whether the zone exists in the IANA database is a code check.
